sentences.zh: 上周，《每日秀》制作人丹尼尔·吉梅特回访了罗森伯格医生了解最新情况。

sentences.en: How are you doing?

sentences.en: Good.

sentences.en: Employees and everybody are talking to each other, saying hi to one another.
sentences.zh: 背景听起来确实很欢乐，听到这个感觉很好。

sentences.en: It does sound very jovial in the background, which is great to hear.
sentences.zh: 我不想用“欢乐”这个词，但大家都很高兴能打上这个疫苗。

sentences.en: I don't want to use the word jovial, but people are happy to get this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们都想打这个疫苗。

sentences.en: They want to get this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们想保护自己。

sentences.en: They want to protect their patients.
sentences.zh: 气氛并不凝重。

sentences.en: And the mood is not somber.
sentences.zh: 气氛是很多人既有点兴奋又有点紧张。

sentences.en: The mood is that a lot of people are somewhat excited and somewhat nervous.
sentences.zh: 这是一支新疫苗。

sentences.en: It's a new vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这一点，但他们很高兴能推动医学进步，推动国民健康向前发展，并且成为某种比自身更伟大的事物的一部分。

sentences.en: They know that, but they're excited to move progress forward, move the health of the nation forward, and be sort of something that's larger than themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，能成为其中一部分具有划时代的意义。

sentences.en: And so, it's kind of monumentous to be part of this.

sentences.en: and fend it out, well, here in the hospital, we have a long corridor, and you have this line of employees to get vaccinated, extending down this corridor, much like the old polio

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.zh: 没有，我很好。

sentences.en: No, I'm good.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.zh: 我想我已经把所有内容都看过了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Tell me what's going on.
sentences.zh: 告诉我发生了什么。

sentences.en: Little pinch.
sentences.zh: 稍微刺痛一下。

sentences.en: We're done.
sentences.zh: 我们完成了。

sentences.en: No pain from the vaccine whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 接种疫苗后一点也没有痛感。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 给我两秒钟。

sentences.en: Let me just save something, go to someplace a little less loud.
sentences.zh: 让我先保存点东西，去一个稍微安静一点的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Well, while you're doing that, let me ask you, in terms of COVID cases at the hospital, how are you, how are things going?
sentences.zh: 嗯，趁你做这个的时候，我想问你，就医院里的新冠病例而言，你怎么样，情况怎么样？

sentences.en: It's calmed down a fair amount.
sentences.zh: 已经平静了不少。

sentences.en: We are seeing an increasing in COVID cases specifically.
sentences.zh: 我们看到新冠确诊病例明显在增加。

sentences.en: Our ICU is almost full.
sentences.zh: 我们的重症监护室几乎满了。

sentences.en: We have a couple empty beds.
sentences.zh: 我们还有几张空床位。

sentences.en: As time has gone on, we've learned a lot more about the disease.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们对这种疾病有了更多的了解。

sentences.en: And the truth is, is we're now finally having some semblance of might work, might not work.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们现在终于有了一些可能管用、可能不管用的头绪。

sentences.en: And to be honest, a fair amount of, we still don't have a solid idea.
sentences.zh: 老实说，很大程度上我们仍然没有一个确切的概念。

sentences.en: But we're months out and we've had time to develop some newer drugs and treatments that the vaccines are now coming right out of the block means that there has been a fair amount of success in trying to slow this,
sentences.zh: 但已经过去好几个月了，我们有时间开发了一些较新的药物和疗法，而疫苗现在也刚开始投入使用，这意味着在试图减缓疫情方面已经取得了相当大的成功，

sentences.en: although it may not be to the degree that we'd like.
sentences.zh: 尽管可能没有达到我们希望的程度。

sentences.en: Is the death rate at your hospital different compared to the spring?
sentences.zh: 你们医院的死亡率和春天相比有不同吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: It is lower.
sentences.zh: 比以前低了。

sentences.en: We still, unfortunately, have some people in their 50s and 60s who have passed away from it during this time, this recent time.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在这段时间里，最近这段时间，我们仍然有一些五六十岁的患者因病离世。

sentences.en: That being said, there are a fair number of patients who I think are recovering and going home who might not otherwise.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我认为有相当一部分患者正在康复并回家，如果不是这样的话，他们可能就不会这样了。

sentences.en: There was one recent patient we had where their family members were actually able to get one of the newer antibody treatments.
sentences.zh: 我们最近有一位患者，他们的家属实际上设法获得了一种较新的抗体疗法。

sentences.en: And that's an option that just didn't exist back then.
sentences.zh: 这是当时根本不存在的一个选择。

sentences.en: But if anything, what do you still not have enough of?
sentences.zh: 但如果说有什么的话，你们现在仍然最缺什么？

sentences.en: I mean, we're very good in terms of equipment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在设备方面我们准备得很充分。

sentences.en: We're good in terms of medications because we don't have the same citywide crunch on medications that we did back then.
sentences.zh: 我们在药物方面也很充足，因为我们没有像当年那样面临全城范围的药物短缺危机。

sentences.en: What happened back then is that everybody suddenly needed a lot of everything and the supplies were limited.
sentences.zh: 当时发生的情况是，每个人突然都需要大量的各种物资，而供应是有限的。

sentences.en: So hospitals got rationing, which was appropriate at the time, but we ran out of things.
sentences.zh: 所以医院开始实行定量配给，这在当时是合适的，但我们确实用光了很多东西。

sentences.en: We have enough of the sedatives that we needed before.
sentences.zh: 我们有足够的以前需要的镇静剂。

sentences.en: We have enough of the vasopressors that we occasionally ran out of before.
sentences.zh: 我们有足够的以前偶尔会用光的血管加压素。

sentences.en: We're in very, very good shape.
sentences.zh: 我们的状况非常好。

sentences.en: But if we have a surge like we did in April and it's as bad as it is and it's that bad in other cities, I could definitely see a run of medications.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们经历像四月份那样激增的疫情，情况和当时一样糟糕，而且在其他城市也这么糟糕的话，我绝对能预见到会出现药物抢购。

sentences.en: So there's just a limited supply of those nationwide.
sentences.zh: 所以全国范围内的供应量是有限的。

sentences.en: So if everybody suddenly needs increased volumes, we'll be in trouble.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果每个人突然都需要增加用量，我们就会陷入困境。

sentences.en: Same thing with all the various types of PPE.
sentences.zh: 各种类型的个人防护装备也是如此。

sentences.en: We're in very good supply now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的供应非常充足。

sentences.en: But if everybody across the nation suddenly needs a tremendous, tremendous amount of stuff, absolutely supply lines could get tight.
sentences.zh: 但如果全国各地的人突然需要极其庞大数量的物资，供应线绝对会变得紧张。

sentences.en: So there's always those supply demand issues that can happen.
sentences.zh: 所以总会有那种可能发生的供需问题。

sentences.en: That being said, I don't see a particular item that I think is going to be a problem point.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我没看出有什么特定的物品会成为问题所在。

sentences.en: What about staffing?
sentences.zh: 人员配备呢？

sentences.en: Staffing is always a, you know, always a question mark.
sentences.zh: 人员配备一直是个，你知道的，一直是个未知数。

sentences.en: And if you have a high index of sick calls, yes, staffing will become an issue again.
sentences.zh: 如果你有很高的病假率，是的，人员配备将再次成为一个问题。

sentences.en: There's just nothing you can do about that.
sentences.zh: 对此你确实无可奈何。

sentences.en: If a third of your workforce is out sick, a third of your workforce is out sick.
sentences.zh: 如果你们三分之一的劳动力因病请假，那就是三分之一的劳动力因病请假。

sentences.en: I guess, though, the fact of hospital staff getting vaccinated now should reduce the risk of people being sick.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，现在医院工作人员接种疫苗这一事实应该会降低人们生病的风险。

sentences.en: I was one of the lucky ones.
sentences.zh: 我是幸运儿之一。

sentences.en: I was enabled to kind of be near the head of the line, which I greatly appreciate because I do have a daily exposure to patients who are COVID positive by the nature of the work.
sentences.zh: 我能够排在队伍的最前面，对此我非常感激，因为由于工作性质，我每天都会接触到新冠检测呈阳性的患者。

sentences.en: And so we tried to hit up those who work in those areas where we have COVID positive patients frequently in the emergency room, the ICUs, the medical floors,
sentences.zh: 所以我们试图优先安排那些在急诊室、重症监护室、内科病房等经常接触新冠阳性患者区域工作的人，

sentences.en: housekeeping slash environmental services.
sentences.zh: 后勤加环境服务人员。

sentences.en: Because the floors where those people work, where they tend to have exposures, and we got a good turnout for it.
sentences.zh: 因为这些人工作的楼层，他们往往会有接触风险，我们为此获得了很高的接种率。

sentences.en: And I think vaccine acceptance has overall been very high.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为疫苗的接受度总体上非常高。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So with the hospital staff getting vaccinations, I guess I wonder, is there like a lighter mood or something at the hospital?
sentences.zh: 那么随着医院工作人员接种疫苗，我在想，医院里的气氛是不是轻松了一些？

sentences.en: Like do things like amongst the staff, is there just like a sort of a sense of relief or something?
sentences.zh: 比如员工之间，是不是有一种如释重负的感觉之类的？

sentences.en: There is a light.
sentences.zh: 确实有一道曙光。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There is a light.
sentences.zh: 确实有希望。

sentences.en: Yes, there is a sense of relief that this may finally be coming to an end.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一种如释重负的感觉，觉得这可能终于要结束了。

sentences.en: This darkness, maybe, just maybe, the craziness and the utter insanity that was last winter and everything else.
sentences.zh: 这种黑暗，也许，只是也许，去年冬天的疯狂和彻底的荒谬以及其他一切。

sentences.en: There's a light at the end of the tunnel and it's coming to an end.
sentences.zh: 隧道尽头见到了曙光，一切都要结束了。

sentences.en: And the vaccine is that first step in really being the disease under control if people are willing to take it.
sentences.zh: 如果人们愿意接种的话，疫苗就是真正控制这种疾病的第一步。

sentences.en: Just, you know, as a doctor and a scientist, it's to me still mind-blowing that they could create an effective, safe vaccine in that little time and get it out to all of us.
sentences.zh: 只是，你知道的，作为一名医生和科学家，在我看来，他们能在这么短的时间内开发出一种有效、安全的疫苗并分发给我们所有人，这依然令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: It's to me mind-blowing because I know how long it took to do all these other vaccines in history.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说简直不可思议，因为我知道历史上研发所有这些其他疫苗花了多长时间。

sentences.en: And so it's really a sense of all at that.
sentences.zh: 所以这真是一种惊叹的感觉。

sentences.en: And I'm, you know, kind of just taken aback by it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我简直有点震惊。

sentences.en: Listen, thank you so much for making some time and, you know, good luck with the rest of your day.
sentences.zh: 听着，非常感谢你抽出时间，祝你接下来的一天一切顺利。
